blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Government workers are pressing the government to raise the proposed increase in the Personnel Economic Relief Allowance (PERA) to P5,000, saying the P500 increase included in the proposed 2027 national budget is insufficient. The All Government Employee Unity has been pushing for a higher PERA, which has remained at P2,000 since its introduction in 2009. The allowance is intended to supplement government workers’ salaries and provide economic relief amid rising costs.
